Databricks AI Search

Databricks AI Search (formerly Databricks Vector Search) is a search solution that is built into the Databricks Data + AI Platform and integrated with its governance and productivity tools. It powers retrieval for AI applications such as RAG systems, recommender systems, and image and video recognition by finding the embeddings most similar to a query.

With Databricks AI Search, you create an AI Search index from a source table, which can be a Delta Lake table, streaming table, or managed table using Iceberg v3 or above. The index includes embedded data with metadata.

AI Search supports the following:

  • Hybrid keyword-similarity search.
  • Filtering.
  • Reranking.

How does AI Search work?​

AI Search uses the Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) algorithm for its approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) searches and the L2 distance metric to measure embedding vector similarity.

AI Search also supports hybrid keyword-similarity search, which combines vector-based embedding search with traditional keyword-based search techniques.

Keyword search algorithm​

Relevance scores are calculated using Okapi BM25. The tokenization function splits at word boundaries, removes punctuation, and converts all text to lowercase.

Options for providing vector embeddings​

To create an AI Search index in Databricks, you must first decide how to provide vector embeddings. Databricks supports three options.

note

It is not possible to convert a self-managed embedding index to a Databricks-managed index.

from databricks.ai_search.client import AISearchClient
client = AISearchClient()
OptionEmbeddings
Delta SyncDatabricks-managed
Direct Vector AccessSelf-managed

Dedicated full-text search indexes are only available on storage-optimized endpoints and require triggered sync mode.
